title: Productionize Tactus procedure layer for Kanbus orchestration
description:
Goal: make Kanbus orchestration production-ready with Tactus as the procedure layer, without replacing Kanbus.

Principles:
- Kanbus remains the source of truth for issues, claims, leases, run records, validation, commits, pushes, and PR publication.
- Tactus procedures orchestrate bounded agent work inside Kanbus-owned workspaces and capability boundaries.
- We control both Kanbus and Tactus, so missing runtime/tooling capabilities should become explicit follow-up work instead of awkward local workarounds.
- Default behavior should be safe for AI agents: narrow task context, constrained tools, durable evidence, clear recovery, and no accidental project artifact mutation.

Current proof:
- A small Tactus worker integration successfully claimed a Call Criteria task, updated README.md, commented on the assigned task, validated, pushed, and opened a PR through Kanbus.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Recommended initial sequence:
1. Write the architecture note so future work has a stable north star.
2. Implement validation profiles because the Call Criteria smoke test exposed why one default gate is not enough.
3. Improve PR/commit evidence generation next, since the current orchestration path works but the output quality is still not production-grade.
4. Use the Tactus platform-gap tasks to decide what should move into Tactus rather than becoming Kanbus-only workaround code.
